buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply

Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): 1.1.Tender specific authorization of OEM for All in One and Printer. 2. WIndows Hardware Compatibility cert ifi cate for offered model of All in One. . 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of SR.DFM/AJMER payable at AJMER . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C SR.DFM/AJMER . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of SR.DFM/AJMER payable at AJMER . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of SR.DFM/AJMER payable at AJMER . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of

SR.DFM/AJMER A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder should not quote any deviation in any uploaded document. The buyer reserves th e right, at their discretion, to ignore any such deviation, if quoted, while issuing the contrac t. 2. Past performance shall be considered up to the last three financial years and current fina ncial year up t o the date of tender/ bid opening. 3. For past performance firm should attach proof of supply signed by eit her the purchaser, the consignee, inspector nominated by the purchaser (should not be a firm representati ve). For this purpose receipt note, inspection certificate, CRAC, receipt challan, work completion certificat e etc should be attached. Proof of supply should clearly indicate the quantity suppl ied and the date of sup ply. Only a copy of PO self-signed ta x invoice, self self-made perfor mance statement does not establish th at the supply has been completed. Bidders should pl ease note that proof of supply as detailed above, is re quired for past performance. 4. Bidders registered (on date of bid opening) with Railways for the trade group of tendered items will be e xempted to Pay EMD. 5. EMD paid Offline should reach Buyer's office i.e. Officer of Sr DMM, DRM Office 1st floor , Ajmer Division. Any delay in the delivery of EMD or delivery the wrong address will be on th e bidder’s account. 6. As per the Ministry of MSME circular F 1(2)1/2016-MA dated 09.02.2017 para (i), Traders are not eligible for the benefits of MSE policy like EMD exemption and purchase preference. Bidders who are traders in this bid may please note this. 7. Picture of the item available on GEM will not be considered part of the offer/contract/. Th e officer will be evaluated based on technical parameters, and the Contract will be based o n the same technical paramete rs. 8. In case bidders participate as an authorized agent of OEM, then past performance as req uired for Eligibi lity Criteria shall be that of the Principal, authorizing the agent. It may so ha ppen that the agent has a Cre dential of past supply for a different Principal, but this will not be counted as performance for evaluation a gainst the Eligibility Criteria, in case of a Chang e of Principal. 9. This bid-specific authorization of OEM is required for the All-in-One offered and the Printer offered. 10. Warranty of the product will have to be honoured by Firm/OEM. In case more than 5% o f PO Qty (for Ai O) is rejected/attended under the warranty period, it will be considered as a n epidemic failure, and the rail way reserves the right to get the entire quantity replaced. P oor performance of OEM will be noted for suita ble action in such cases. 11. Condition for Security Deposit (1) Firms are advised to Submit SD @ 5% of contract Val ue in favor of S r DFM NWR AJMER in Prescribed Performa Within 15 days of Gem Contract is sued. Failing to which incident will be raised on Gem. After submission of SD suitable M.A in Purchase Order will be issued. (2) If you mak e a bank guarantee, then get IFSC code SBIN0 00RAIL quoted in the bank guarantee so that BG verification can be done online. (Detail att ached with PO) (3) The BG should be accompanied with a stamp of 0.25% o f the BG amoun t and the stamp should be issued against the Bank Guarantee head. (4) If stamp worth0.2 5 % of the Bank Guarantee Amount are not attached under the Bank guarantee head then th e BG will be c onsidered incomplete and will not be accepted. . 1 .
